  • At least 6 years of experience working with enterprise customers in a Customer Success or Account Management type role at a SaaS company
  • Supply Chain industry experience preferred

raw.excerpt: A little bit about our teamSureel AI is building the standards and infrastructure for AI rights, licensing, attribution, protection, and intelligence, starting in music and expanding across media.
raw.description:
A little bit about our team

Sureel AI is building the standards and infrastructure for AI rights, licensing, attribution, protection, and intelligence, starting in music and expanding across media.

We are building the infrastructure that enables creators and rights holders to control how their work is used by AI, protect their rights, understand its use and value, and participate in new AI licensing models. We also provide AI companies and digital platforms with the systems they need to access rights, permissions, attribution, guardrails, reporting, and licensing infrastructure programmatically.

Acquired by Warner Music Group, Sureel operates as an independent, federated company, combining startup speed with the reach of a global music company.

Our commercial relationships sit at the heart of what we're building: with the AI companies and digital service providers (DSPs) who integrate our attribution infrastructure into their platforms, and with the rights holders whose works and interests that infrastructure protects. As Director, Business Development & Licensing, you'll own the business function across both sides of that equation, working closely with senior leadership, cross-functional teams, and external partners across the music, technology, and legal worlds. Your work will directly shape the commercial architecture of AI attribution at scale.

Your role

You will lead Sureel's business function, reporting to the CEO and two Co-Presidents. This is a senior, commercially focused role. When Sureel is negotiating with a service provider or a rights holder, you will own the business function of that negotiation.

You will also serve as Sureel's primary liaison with industry bodies such as DDEX and regulatory bodies such as WIPO where their activities relate to Sureel's business.

A key part of the role will be developing business models and modeling outcomes for charging clients, including DSPs and AI companies. A strong understanding of economics and music rights will be important.

Your objective is to structure agreements that increase adoption of Sureel's infrastructure, create repeatable commercial models, and establish frameworks that can scale across multiple rights holders, AI companies, and markets.

You will negotiate licensing models, revenue structures, payment flows, and the economic frameworks that determine how permissions through Sureel's technology translate into compensation. You will also oversee the business use cases for integrating Sureel's infrastructure with AI companies and DSPs, defining what a commercially viable integration looks like and structuring the terms around it.

You'll work closely with Product and Client Relations. They will bring the product and partner perspectives, while you will lead the commercial structure and economics that support the business.

This is an opportunity to help define the business function of a company working in a new and evolving area, and to help shape how creators are compensated in the age of AI.

What you'll do:

  • Own the business function for Sureel's negotiations, whether with AI companies, DSPs, other digital service providers, or rights holders, leading commercial strategy, deal structure, and terms from first conversation through signature.

  • Negotiate the economics of platform integrations, including licensing models, revenue structures, payment flows, and frameworks that reflect the value of Sureel's technology alongside rights holders' catalog and distribution positions.

  • Develop the business use cases for integrating Sureel's infrastructure with AI companies and DSPs, defining commercial success and prioritizing opportunities based on enterprise value.

  • Develop licensing and economic frameworks for an emerging category, using relevant AI and rights-technology transactions to inform agreements that can work across different partners and markets.

  • Structure multi-stakeholder commercial arrangements among rights holders and industry participants, positioning Sureel's infrastructure as the mechanism for executing those agreements.

  • Partner with Client Relations on rights-holder relationships, owning the commercial terms and deal economics while they lead the broader relationship and delivery.

  • Work closely with Warner Music Group counterparts on commercial terms, licensing structures, and strategic priorities.

  • Provide market intelligence on emerging technologies, competitive developments, licensing innovation, and deal dynamics across the AI and DSP landscape.

  • Represent Sureel with industry and standards organizations, including DDEX, WIPO, and other initiatives shaping AI rights and licensing.

  • Develop pricing and packaging for Sureel's platform, including enterprise fees, API and usage-based pricing, transaction fees, revenue share, licensing administration, analytics, and hybrid structures.

  • Create repeatable commercial and licensing frameworks that can scale across partners rather than requiring every agreement to be built from scratch.

  • Help structure how Sureel infrastructure is used in commercial agreements, including rights, permissions, guardrails, attribution, reporting, and economic obligations between rights holders and AI companies.

  • Handle confidential and proprietary information, including deal terms, partner economics, and negotiations with discretion and integrity.

  • Help shape emerging industry standards and licensing frameworks so they can be implemented programmatically and work with Sureel's architecture.

Who you are:

  • You have deep experience structuring and negotiating commercial agreements in music, media, or technology, including licensing deals, platform integrations, revenue-share structures, or rights-technology transactions.

  • You've owned the business side of negotiations with platforms, DSPs, technology companies, or rights holders and carried complex deals from term sheet through signature.

  • You understand the economics of the music industry: how rights generate revenue, how licensing frameworks are built, and how value flows between platforms, intermediaries, and rights holders.

  • You're comfortable with data and financial detail. You can model a revenue structure, pressure-test assumptions, and explain the business logic clearly to technical teams and senior counterparties.

  • You can structure complex deals and find approaches that work for the different parties involved.

  • You build trust quickly and can represent leadership in high-stakes negotiations, make judgment calls on terms, and know when to escalate.

  • You communicate clearly in writing and in person and can stay calm in a fast-moving environment.

  • You understand how pricing, licensing structures, technical standards, and ecosystem incentives can support platform adoption and durable commercial outcomes.

  • You are interested in the music industry and enjoy working in a small, collaborative, startup-paced team.

We'd love it if you also had:

  • Direct experience negotiating with AI companies, DSPs, or other digital service providers on licensing, integration, or commercial partnership terms.

  • Experience working with artists, labels, publishers, or CMOs/PROs on the commercial side, or serving as a senior deal advisor to them.

  • Experience across deal structuring and licensing, business development, commercial strategy, or partnerships.

  • Involvement in industry licensing, standards, or policy initiatives shaping how AI and rights interact.

  • Experience working directly with C-level executives on commercial strategy, negotiation preparation, and translating senior conversations into agreements.

  • Experience developing commercial models for infrastructure, APIs, marketplaces, payments, rights technology, or other platforms where value is monetized across multiple layers of a transaction.

  • Curiosity about the music and entertainment landscape and AI's impact on creators.

Sureel AI is an independent, federated company within Warner Music Group. We're committed to building a diverse team and to fair recognition for creators everywhere.

raw.description:
A little bit about our team

Sureel AI is building the standards and infrastructure for AI rights, licensing, attribution, protection, and intelligence, starting in music and expanding across media.

We are building the infrastructure that enables creators and rights holders to control how their work is used by AI, protect their rights, understand its use and value, and participate in new AI licensing models. We also provide AI companies and digital platforms with the systems they need to access rights, permissions, attribution, guardrails, reporting, and licensing infrastructure programmatically.

Acquired by Warner Music Group, Sureel operates as an independent, federated company, combining startup speed with the reach of a global music company.

Our commercial relationships sit at the heart of what we're building: with the AI companies and digital service providers (DSPs) who integrate our attribution infrastructure into their platforms, and with the rights holders whose works and interests that infrastructure protects. As Director, Business Development & Licensing, you'll own the business function across both sides of that equation, working closely with senior leadership, cross-functional teams, and external partners across the music, technology, and legal worlds. Your work will directly shape the commercial architecture of AI attribution at scale.

Your role

You will lead Sureel's business function, reporting to the CEO and two Co-Presidents. This is a senior, commercially focused role. When Sureel is negotiating with a service provider or a rights holder, you will own the business function of that negotiation.

You will also serve as Sureel's primary liaison with industry bodies such as DDEX and regulatory bodies such as WIPO where their activities relate to Sureel's business.

A key part of the role will be developing business models and modeling outcomes for charging clients, including DSPs and AI companies. A strong understanding of economics and music rights will be important.

Your objective is to structure agreements that increase adoption of Sureel's infrastructure, create repeatable commercial models, and establish frameworks that can scale across multiple rights holders, AI companies, and markets.

You will negotiate licensing models, revenue structures, payment flows, and the economic frameworks that determine how permissions through Sureel's technology translate into compensation. You will also oversee the business use cases for integrating Sureel's infrastructure with AI companies and DSPs, defining what a commercially viable integration looks like and structuring the terms around it.

You'll work closely with Product and Client Relations. They will bring the product and partner perspectives, while you will lead the commercial structure and economics that support the business.

This is an opportunity to help define the business function of a company working in a new and evolving area, and to help shape how creators are compensated in the age of AI.

What you'll do:

  • Own the business function for Sureel's negotiations, whether with AI companies, DSPs, other digital service providers, or rights holders, leading commercial strategy, deal structure, and terms from first conversation through signature.

  • Negotiate the economics of platform integrations, including licensing models, revenue structures, payment flows, and frameworks that reflect the value of Sureel's technology alongside rights holders' catalog and distribution positions.

  • Develop the business use cases for integrating Sureel's infrastructure with AI companies and DSPs, defining commercial success and prioritizing opportunities based on enterprise value.

  • Develop licensing and economic frameworks for an emerging category, using relevant AI and rights-technology transactions to inform agreements that can work across different partners and markets.

  • Structure multi-stakeholder commercial arrangements among rights holders and industry participants, positioning Sureel's infrastructure as the mechanism for executing those agreements.

  • Partner with Client Relations on rights-holder relationships, owning the commercial terms and deal economics while they lead the broader relationship and delivery.

  • Work closely with Warner Music Group counterparts on commercial terms, licensing structures, and strategic priorities.

  • Provide market intelligence on emerging technologies, competitive developments, licensing innovation, and deal dynamics across the AI and DSP landscape.

  • Represent Sureel with industry and standards organizations, including DDEX, WIPO, and other initiatives shaping AI rights and licensing.

  • Develop pricing and packaging for Sureel's platform, including enterprise fees, API and usage-based pricing, transaction fees, revenue share, licensing administration, analytics, and hybrid structures.

  • Create repeatable commercial and licensing frameworks that can scale across partners rather than requiring every agreement to be built from scratch.

  • Help structure how Sureel infrastructure is used in commercial agreements, including rights, permissions, guardrails, attribution, reporting, and economic obligations between rights holders and AI companies.

  • Handle confidential and proprietary information, including deal terms, partner economics, and negotiations with discretion and integrity.

  • Help shape emerging industry standards and licensing frameworks so they can be implemented programmatically and work with Sureel's architecture.

Who you are:

  • You have deep experience structuring and negotiating commercial agreements in music, media, or technology, including licensing deals, platform integrations, revenue-share structures, or rights-technology transactions.

  • You've owned the business side of negotiations with platforms, DSPs, technology companies, or rights holders and carried complex deals from term sheet through signature.

  • You understand the economics of the music industry: how rights generate revenue, how licensing frameworks are built, and how value flows between platforms, intermediaries, and rights holders.

  • You're comfortable with data and financial detail. You can model a revenue structure, pressure-test assumptions, and explain the business logic clearly to technical teams and senior counterparties.

  • You can structure complex deals and find approaches that work for the different parties involved.

  • You build trust quickly and can represent leadership in high-stakes negotiations, make judgment calls on terms, and know when to escalate.

  • You communicate clearly in writing and in person and can stay calm in a fast-moving environment.

  • You understand how pricing, licensing structures, technical standards, and ecosystem incentives can support platform adoption and durable commercial outcomes.

  • You are interested in the music industry and enjoy working in a small, collaborative, startup-paced team.

We'd love it if you also had:

  • Direct experience negotiating with AI companies, DSPs, or other digital service providers on licensing, integration, or commercial partnership terms.

  • Experience working with artists, labels, publishers, or CMOs/PROs on the commercial side, or serving as a senior deal advisor to them.

  • Experience across deal structuring and licensing, business development, commercial strategy, or partnerships.

  • Involvement in industry licensing, standards, or policy initiatives shaping how AI and rights interact.

  • Experience working directly with C-level executives on commercial strategy, negotiation preparation, and translating senior conversations into agreements.

  • Experience developing commercial models for infrastructure, APIs, marketplaces, payments, rights technology, or other platforms where value is monetized across multiple layers of a transaction.

  • Curiosity about the music and entertainment landscape and AI's impact on creators.

Sureel AI is an independent, federated company within Warner Music Group. We're committed to building a diverse team and to fair recognition for creators everywhere.

Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Summary

About us

Chronosphere, a Palo Alto Networks company, is the observability platform built for control in the modern, containerized world. Chronosphere empowers customers to focus on the data and insights that matter by reducing complexity, optimizing costs, and remediating issues faster. Chronosphere reduces data volumes and associated costs by 84% on average while saving developers thousands of hours. Recognized as a leader by major analyst firms, Chronosphere is trusted by the world's most innovative brands, including DoorDash, Affirm, and Zillow.

About the role

Chronosphere, a Palo Alto Networks company, is looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead foundational areas of our Storage and Cost Optimization tiers. You’ll operate with one foot in the factory and one foot in the field, bridging between our customers and our engineering team, building feedback loops, and testing hypotheses. You must be comfortable with a deeply technical product that serves a deeply technical audience. Along with building great products, you’ll drive the messaging and storytelling for how these products help solve problems for developers.

We run two lanes: a validation track to choose and specify what to build, and an agile build track to get it delivered. You’ll be responsible for both.

Qualifications

You will

  • Perform primary research, interviewing end-users and buyers.

  • Build a researched perspective on current customer and future prospects needs.

  • Deeply understand the competition.

  • Set priorities and shape the roadmap.

  • Communicate priorities and the roadmap, and align the team around them.

  • Convert concepts into buildable projects.

  • Act as product owner for a Scrum team working on observability features.

  • Manage the backlog, groom stories, and break down tasks.

  • Coordinate with product marketing on positioning and messaging.

  • Drive clarity.

What you will achieve

You will start off in your role understanding the current roadmap and plans as a way to learn our product and gain insight to customer needs. While you execute on the short-term roadmap, you’ll establish your independent perspective on the state and evolution of the Cost Optimization and Storage needs of the market through ride-alongs in customer conversations, doing your own research and internal conversations with experts and learning from internal teams.

Following this initial period, you will take full ownership of the Cost Optimization product area and parts of the Storage tier, establish problem statements, PRDs, drive scrum meetings, sprint planning, including ownership of success metrics, establishing/changing pricing when required, defining SLOs, establishing and managing to a COGS profile and working cross functionally across Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales and other functions to help GTM teams position and independently sell.

The main success criteria of this role is to be able to chart the best possible path and execute on those plans and deliver value to customers. An ongoing task thereafter is to take these new capabilities to the next level by staying close to customers and prospects.

You have

  • 5+ years of experience as a product manager on a B2B Cloud native product.

  • A track record of delivering software with agile processes and tight feedback loops.

  • Experience working with customers and prospects

  • Experience building and operating software as a service.

  • The ability to turn customer research into a coherent strategy

  • Strong focus on the small details that make products loved and usable

  • Experience partnering with UX to build delightful features.

  • Experience working with or building data storage tiers

  • No fear of diving deep into the world of cloud-native monitoring and troubleshooting

raw.description:
About Us

Shorthand exists to empower creative teams to produce and publish beautiful, transformative content radically faster. We've begun our journey by creating an easy-to-use platform for one of the most creatively and technically demanding use cases on the web — immersive feature stories — and we're proud to count many of the world's best known and most discerning publishers, brands, not-for-profits and universities as loyal customers.

Shorthand is a growing, investor-backed company with customers on every continent (except Antarctica!), and there's never been a more exciting time to join our band of geeks with art and heart.

We're looking for an entrepreneurial Senior Account Executive to join our Sales team, based in North America (Washington DC, NYC, or Boston preferred; other East Coast locations considered) on a fully remote basis.

What you'll be doing

The mission of Shorthand is to create a beautifully informed world. To do that, we need to build a platform that makes it easy to create immersive reading experiences for the web, because it would otherwise be unaffordable and painfully cumbersome for organisations to produce this type of content.

Our Senior Account Executives are a big part of the Shorthand magic. This role is responsible for building pipeline, opening new enterprise relationships, and driving complex consultative sales cycles.

You'll engage both business and technical stakeholders — including marketing, content, editorial, digital experience and web platform teams — and operate autonomously across the full sales cycle, from prospecting through to close. This is an ideal role for someone who thrives in early-stage product commercialisation and enjoys creating structure, messaging and momentum in a new market category.

You'll join our Sales team and report to the Head of Sales.

In this role you'll:

  • Build and manage a disciplined outbound pipeline targeting enterprise organisations.
  • Prospect into marketing, content, communications, digital experience and web platform teams within medium and large enterprises.
  • Develop multi-threaded relationships across both business and technical buying groups.
  • Create and execute strategic account plans for named target accounts.
  • Become a trusted advisor by understanding customer priorities and demonstrating how Shorthand supports their strategic objectives.
  • Build long-term relationships with senior stakeholders while driving new business and expansion opportunities.
  • Develop tailored proposals and presentations that address customer needs and business outcomes.
  • Own commercial negotiations and successfully close complex enterprise opportunities.
  • Forecast pipeline accurately, including expected close date, projected deal size and probability.
  • Work collaboratively with Customer Success, Sales, Channel Partners, Growth, Marketing, Product and Engineering to deliver outstanding customer outcomes and provide valuable market feedback.

We are looking for someone who:

  • Has a proven track record of building outbound pipeline and closing enterprise SaaS deals in complex buying environments.
  • Is comfortable prospecting into medium and large enterprises and engaging multiple stakeholder groups across marketing, content, communications, editorial, digital and web platform teams.
  • Can demonstrate success growing strategic accounts through a combination of new business acquisition, expansion and executive relationship building.
  • Has experience selling CMS, digital publishing, martech, DXP or related technology solutions into enterprise organisations.
  • Is commercially driven, highly autonomous, and comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment with limited structure and high ownership.
  • Is technically credible and confident discussing CMS workflows, integrations and implementation considerations with customer web and platform teams.
  • Can independently run discovery, product demonstrations and commercial conversations without relying heavily on presales or solution engineering support.
  • Has strong consultative selling skills and can connect Shorthand's platform capabilities to strategic customer objectives around content, storytelling, engagement and digital experience.
  • Communicates exceptionally well in both written and verbal formats, and can simplify complex concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Learns quickly, prioritises effectively, and maintains high attention to detail while managing multiple enterprise sales cycles simultaneously.
  • Thrives working remotely and collaboratively across distributed teams and time zones.
  • Brings curiosity, resilience and initiative, and enjoys helping shape go-to-market strategy for emerging products and categories.

Experience & Qualifications

  • Significant experience successfully selling enterprise marketing solutions to CEOs, CMOs, VPs and Directors of Marketing, Content, Communications, Editorial and related functions.
  • Experience selling into organisations using WordPress, Adobe Experience Manager, Sitecore, Contentful, Optimizely, Drupal or similar CMS/DXP platforms.

  • Ability to independently deliver product demonstrations and manage technical discovery conversations without dedicated presales support.
  • Experience introducing new products to market.
  • Proven track record of closing large, strategic, high-quality deals.
  • Proven success in both direct and partner-led sales.
  • Technical aptitude or background in technology is highly regarded.
  • A consultative sales style and experience selling solutions in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proven ability to sell collaboratively across multiple internal stakeholders and teams.

Personality Attributes

  • You are a proactive self-starter who doesn't need to be told what to do and is resourceful in finding solutions.
  • You are collaborative, consultative and not afraid to get your hands dirty.
  • You thrive in a fast-paced environment and possess a high level of curiosity.
  • You are goal-oriented, resilient and motivated by achieving outstanding results.
  • You are a supportive and proactive team player.
  • You love working remotely.
  • You are tech-savvy and excited to become an expert in the Shorthand platform.

Why work for us

We offer:

  • Fully remote working, flexible hours and a co-working allowance if you'd like one.
  • True autonomy, with the freedom to own and grow your territory.
  • The opportunity to shape our enterprise sales motion as we continue to grow across North America.
  • A category-defining product trusted by leading global brands, publishers, universities and not-for-profits.
  • The opportunity to work in a growing SaaS company that's still small enough for you to make a real impact.
  • A home office allowance, laptop and any peripherals you need to do your best work.
  • An Employee Share Option Plan for all team members.
  • A Health & Wellness Allowance together with access to coaching and counselling services.
  • A 401(k) plan and 100% employer-paid healthcare premiums for US-based team members.

We value direct communication and want to be transparent about how we hire. Our process includes:

Overview

Dane Street is seeking experienced Board-Certified Dentists to join our growing team of expert clinical reviewers. In this role, you will apply your dental expertise to conduct comprehensive reviews of clinical cases and provide objective, evidence-based dental advisory opinions.

This is a fully remote opportunity that allows you to customize your schedule while working as a 1099 independent contractor.

Your primary responsibilities will include reviewing dental records and clinical documentation, preparing clear and concise clinical summaries, and responding to specific questions from our clients related to dental care. This role involves advisory dental record reviews only and does not involve peer-to-peer discussions, calls, or direct patient care.

We are currently seeking professionals with expertise in:

  • Current, unrestricted Washington dental license
  • Minimum of 5+ years of clinical dental experience

Benefits

  • Independent consultant role offering schedule flexibility and predictable work hours

  • No peer-to-peer calls or discussions

  • Dane Street manages administrative processes, dental record organization, and communications

  • Initial training provided, along with ongoing support and a dedicated point of contact
  • Fully remote work from anywhere in Washington State

raw.description:
FICO (NYSE: FICO)is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100+ countries make better decisions. Join our world-class team today and fulfill your career potential!

The Opportunity

As Senior Director of AI Engineering, you will lead innovation and strategic growth across FICO's platform. Working at the forefront of our Generative AI efforts, you'll drive the application of large language models and cutting-edge AI technologies to enhance fraud detection, streamline decision authoring, automate customer communication workflows, and optimize overall performance. You will set the technical vision for our AI systems, ensuring they are robust, scalable, and responsibly governed. Most importantly, you'll lead a high-performing engineering team to deliver transformative AI solutions that address real business challenges and advance FICO's platform capabilities.

What You'll Contribute

  • Lead, develop, and coach a high-performing engineering team by fostering a culture of aligned autonomy, clear communication, and continuous learning — while actively recruiting top talent and setting clear direction for hiring strategies.

  • Drive the design and implementation of AI solutions — including LLM-powered decision automation, fraud detection, and process optimization — to strengthen FICO's position as a market leader.

  • Partner with stakeholders and product managers to understand business priorities and translate them into actionable engineering roadmaps that harness advanced AI capabilities for meaningful outcomes.

  • Define best practices for model evaluation, governance, and monitoring to ensure AI systems remain accurate, reliable, secure, and compliant at scale.

  • Build and maintain systems for continuous model monitoring, A/B testing, backtesting, and drift detection to keep deployed models performing at their best over time.

  • Collaborate closely with UX designers, product teams, and engineering leaders to align AI capabilities across the platform and deliver a cohesive user experience.

What We're Seeking

  • Proven experience building and leading engineering teams to deliver advanced AI solutions, with deep expertise in Large Language Models and their application to decision automation, fraud detection, and process optimization.

  • 15+ years of industry experience in software, machine learning, or data engineering, with a demonstrated history of leading complex, large-scale projects and applying LLMs to solve real-world challenges.

  • A track record of effective leadership, coaching, and mentoring that fosters innovation, accountability, and a high-performance culture in dynamic, fast-paced environments.

  • Hands-on experience with model fine-tuning, in-context learning, and custom evaluation frameworks, alongside a strong command of backtesting, A/B testing, and drift detection methodologies to ensure reliable model performance in production.

  • Solid understanding of model monitoring, governance, and compliance practices, with a commitment to responsible AI and the ability to architect scalable, secure, AI and data-driven systems that meet rigorous production standards.

  • Familiarity with compliance and regulatory requirements in AI-driven decisioning environments, and a working knowledge of modern software engineering practices and design patterns.

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to work across departments and align engineering efforts to broader business goals.

  • Thought leadership in AI and machine learning — through publications, patents, or open-source contributions — is a plus.

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, AI, or a related field.

Our Offer to You

  • An inclusive culture strongly reflecting our core values: Act Like an Owner, Delight Our Customers and Earn the Respect of Others.

  • The opportunity to make an impact and develop professionally by leveraging your unique strengths and participating in valuable learning experiences.

  • Highly competitive compensation, benefits and rewards programs that encourage you to bring your best every day and be recognized for doing so.

  • An engaging, people-first work environment offering work/life balance, employee resource groups, and social events to promote interaction and camaraderie.

  • The targeted base pay range for this role is: $192,500 to $302,500 with this range reflecting differences in candidate knowledge, skills and experience.

Why Make a Move to FICO?

At FICO, you can develop your career with a leading organization in one of the fastest-growing fields in technology today – Big Data analytics. You’ll play a part in our commitment to help businesses use data to improve every choice they make, using advances in artificial intelligence, machine learning, optimization, and much more.

FICO makes a real difference in the way businesses operate worldwide:

• Credit Scoring — FICO® Scores are used by 90 of the top 100 US lenders.

• Fraud Detection and Security — 4 billion payment cards globally are protected by FICO fraud systems.

• Lending — 3/4 of US mortgages are approved using the FICO Score.

Global trends toward digital transformation have created tremendous demand for FICO’s solutions, placing us among the world’s top 100 software companies by revenue. We help many of the world’s largest banks, insurers, retailers, telecommunications providers and other firms reach a new level of success. Our success is dependent on really talented people – just like you – who thrive on the collaboration and innovation that’s nurtured by a diverse and inclusive environment. We’ll provide the support you need, while ensuring you have the freedom to develop your skills and grow your career. Join FICO and help change the way business thinks!

Learn more about how you can fulfil your potential at

FICO promotes a culture of inclusion and seeks to attract a diverse set of candidates for each job opportunity. We are an equal employment opportunity employer and we’re proud to offer employment and advancement opportunities to all candidates without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. Research has shown that women and candidates from underrepresented communities may not apply for an opportunity if they don’t meet all stated qualifications. While our qualifications are clearly related to role success, each candidate’s profile is unique and strengths in certain skill and/or experience areas can be equally effective. If you believe you have many, but not necessarily all, of the stated qualifications we encourage you to apply.

Information submitted with your application is subject to the FICO Privacy policy at

raw.excerpt: Important Notice for Applicants: At Bixal, we want to ensure a transparent and secure application process for all candidates.
raw.description:
Important Notice for Applicants:
At Bixal, we want to ensure a transparent and secure application process for all candidates. Official communication will come from an email address ending in @bixal.com or from @bixal.na.teamtailor-mail.com. Messages from other sources may be fraudulent, and you should exercise care to avoid any links or attachments included.

Bixal will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

Need Assistance or a Reasonable Accommodation?If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation to complete your application, we're here to help. Please reach out to us at and let us know how we can support you. You do not need to share personal details or disclose the nature of your request. You can expect a response from a team member within 24 hours during the regular work week and on the next operating day during the weekend or holidays.

Why Bixal?

Bixal is a consulting company headquartered in Fairfax, VA, working alongside governments and organizations to help them deliver better services and experiences to the communities they serve. Using evidence-based knowledge and technology, Bixal empowers clients to deliver on their missions more effectively by fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement.

Our values:

  • People-First: Emphasizing the importance of people in all aspects of work.

  • Collaboration and Transparency: Valuing teamwork and open communication.

  • Growth Mindset: Encouraging innovation and continuous improvement.

  • Creating Lasting Impact: Focusing on meaningful outcomes and positive change.

About the role:

Bixal is seeking a Principal Data Lead to help lead the strategy, governance, and quality of data on one of our large-scale federal data platform programs. In this role, you'll own execution of the data strategy for a multi-year enterprise data platform, lead the data supply chain, and drive a multi-phase metadata maturity program that raises the bar for how data is documented, trusted, and reused across the platform. You'll govern how data is promoted from initial ingestion through validated, trusted status, set and maintain data quality standards, and serve as the connective tissue between the platform team and the many upstream source-system teams and business data owners who depend on it.

This is foundational work: the metadata and data quality practices you lead are what make it possible to safely expand governed self-service analytics and AI use cases. If you enjoy building durable data governance capability inside a live, high-stakes production environment — not just writing policy — we'd love to hear from you.

This is a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a project that aligns with Bixal’s mission of delivering innovative, human-centered solutions. At Bixal, we support your professional journey, ensuring your experience reflects our, purpose-driven culture and prepares you for future success.

Location:

This role can work remotely from anywhere in the U.S. Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S., be able to obtain and maintain the required Public Trust clearance, and obtain a U.S. Federal Government client badge. Bixal does not sponsor employment visas or assume sponsorship of existing employment visas.

Compensation:

The salary range for this role is $160,000 – $200,000. In the spirit of transparency, most offers tend to land near the midpoint of the range. We make compensation decisions thoughtfully, considering your experience, the skills you bring, and our commitment to internal equity. Fairness and transparency are core to how we operate.

Responsibilities:

  • Own execution of the data strategy for a large-scale enterprise data platform, aligning day-to-day delivery with the organization’s broader data strategy and strategic goals.

  • Serve as the primary coordination point across multiple upstream source-system teams and business data owners, managing handoffs, ingestion readiness, and shared metadata standards across the ecosystem.

  • Lead the data supply chain — source onboarding, ingestion, and transformation — and drive a multi-phase metadata maturity program, treating metadata as an operational capability rather than a one-time cataloging effort.

  • Govern the promotion of data through a tiered catalog architecture (e.g., raw, source, and trusted layers), defining clear admission criteria and applying the model consistently across teams.

  • Set and maintain data quality standards across the platform, including completeness, conformance, freshness against SLAs, and defect/rework tracking.

  • Partner with engineering, product, and AI/platform teams to ensure metadata and data quality are sufficient to support expanding self-service analytics and AI use cases.

  • Establish and track measures of data quality, metadata coverage, and promotion/certification cycle time, and use them to prioritize remediation work.

  • Communicate data strategy progress, risks, and dependencies to technical and non-technical stakeholders, including client leadership.

  • Participate in Agile/SAFe delivery cadences, including planning, backlog refinement, and retrospectives.

  • Other relevant duties as qualified and trained to perform.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field, plus at least 10 years of related experience.

  • Strong track record coordinating across multiple stakeholder teams and data owners in complex, multi-system environments.

  • Demonstrated experience owning or leading a data strategy for a large, multi-source enterprise data platform.

  • Experience designing and operating metadata governance or maturity programs, including cataloging, ownership models, and promotion/certification criteria.

  • Experience with modern cloud data platforms (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake, AWS, or similar) and metadata/catalog tooling (e.g., Unity Catalog, Collibra, Alation, AWS Glue Data Catalog, Microsoft Purview).

  • Experience defining and enforcing data quality standards, including completeness, conformance, freshness, and defect tracking.

  • Working knowledge of distributed data processing concepts and common data programming or query languages (e.g., SQL, Python, Scala), sufficient to engage credibly with engineering teams on pipeline design and performance.

  • Experience defining and enforcing data quality standards, including completeness, conformance, freshness, and defect tracking.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical data concepts for non-technical audiences, including client leadership.

  • Professional certification in a cloud or data platform (e.g., AWS, Databricks), data governance (e.g., DAMA CDMP), or Agile delivery (e.g., SAFe).

  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust security clearance.

Nice to haves:

  • Experience in highly regulated federal data domains (e.g., healthcare, benefits, or financial data).

  • Familiarity with responsible AI governance and how metadata and data quality maturity gate the expansion of AI use cases.

  • Hands-on experience building, tuning, or troubleshooting data pipelines on a cloud lakehouse platform (e.g., Databricks or comparable).

  • Exposure to CI/CD, source control, and observability tooling as applied to data platform and pipeline operations.

  • Experience with data lineage and impact-analysis tooling.

  • Experience supporting or serving in a Key Personnel role on a federal contract.

  • Background in federal digital services delivery.

How We Support Our Team:

  • Flex hours

  • 401K with matching incentive

  • Parental Leave

  • Medical/dental/vision benefits

  • Flex Spending Account

  • Company provided short-term disability and life insurance

  • Commuter benefits

  • Paid Time Off (PTO)

  • 11 Paid holidays

Our company is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all individuals and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local anti-discrimination laws. Employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.

D-Wave Quantum Inc. (NASDAQ: QBTS) is a leader in the development and delivery of quantum computing systems, software, and services. It is the world’s first commercial supplier of quantum computers, and the first and only to offer dual-platform quantum computing products and services, spanning both annealing and gate-model quantum computing technologies. D-Wave’s mission is to help customers realize the value of quantum today through enterprise-grade systems available on-premises and via its Leap™ quantum cloud service, which offers 99.9% availability and uptime. More than 100 organizations across commercial, government, and research sectors trust D-Wave to address complex computational challenges using quantum computing. Learn more about realizing the value of quantum computing today and how D-Wave is shaping the quantum-driven industrial and societal advancements of tomorrow: .

About the role

D-Wave is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Counsel, Corporate & Commercial to join our Legal team. This role is a key individual contributor responsible for providing strategic legal support across a broad range of corporate and commercial matters, including complex business transactions, technology agreements, corporate initiatives, and day-to-day operational legal needs, with a focus on the EMEA region.

Reporting to the VP, Legal you will partner closely with senior leaders and cross-functional teams to deliver practical, business-focused legal advice that enables growth, manages risk, and supports strategic company objectives. You will play a critical role in drafting and negotiating agreements, advising on complex legal matters, and building strong relationships across the organization.

This role is fully remote and open to candidates located in the United Kingdom and Ireland

What you'll do

  • Draft, review, and negotiate complex commercial agreements, including customer, procurement, professional services, software, technology, collaboration, research, and confidentiality agreements.
  • Provide practical legal advice on commercial and corporate matters, balancing legal risk with business priorities.
  • Analyze and resolve complex legal issues arising from business operations, providing timely and actionable guidance with minimal supervision.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams, including Sales, Procurement, Finance, Research & Development, Security, and Operations, to support commercial initiatives and transactions.
  • Support contract lifecycle management, including negotiation strategy, risk assessment, and agreement execution.
  • Proactively identify, address and manage legal risk issues arising in the day-to-day business operations.
  • Provide general legal support across the team on EMEA matters, as needed.
  • Manage relationships with external legal counsel and support specialized legal matters as needed.
  • Stay current on commercial law, technology trends, and industry practices relevant to the company’s business.
  • Work cross-functionally in different time zones with business and legal colleagues worldwide to support the global business.

About You

  • Qualified lawyer in England & Wales or Ireland.
  • 6+ years of experience at a law firm and/or in-house legal department, with significant experience in commercial and corporate matters.
  • Experience drafting, reviewing, and negotiating complex commercial and technology agreements.
  • Strong understanding of commercial law and the ability to provide practical, business-oriented legal advice.
  • Experience supporting business teams in a fast-paced, technology-driven environment.
  • Ability to independently manage complex legal matters, prioritize competing demands, and deliver high-quality work with minimal supervision.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain legal concepts clearly to non-legal audiences.
  • Proactive, collaborative, and solutions-oriented approach with the ability to operate effectively in a dynamic, global environment.

A D-Waver's DNA

  • We look at the future and say “why not”; we see possibilities where others see problems or routines. We show the way ahead and are committed to achieving ambitious goals.
  • We practice straight talk and listen generously to each other with empathy. We value different opinions and points of views. We ensure that we connect outside as well as inside to learn from others and inspire each other.
  • We hold ourselves accountable for delivering results. We make decisions & take responsibility so that we can act & support each other.
  • As leaders we motivate & engage our teams to undertake beyond what they originally thought possible, by developing our teams & creating the conditions for people to grow and empower themselves through enabling & coaching.

Our Compensation Philosophy is Simple but Powerful:

We believe providing D-Wavers with company ownership, competitive pay, and a range of meaningful benefits is the start of creating a culture where people want to give the best they’ve got — not because they’re simply making money, but because they’ve fallen in love with our vision, mission, values, and team.

During the interview process, your Recruiter will review our total rewards (base, equity, bonus, perks, benefit, culture) offerings. The final offer is determined by your proficiencies within this level.

Inclusion:

We celebrate diverse perspectives to drive innovation in our pursuit. Our employees range from distinguished domain experts with decades of experience in their respective fields, to bright and motivated graduates eager to make their mark. Our diverse and innovative team will make you feel appreciated, supported and empower your career growth at D-Wave.

raw.title: Outbound GTM Lead | Colombia
raw.excerpt: HireHawk is a fast-growing staffing and recruitment solutions company helping businesses build high-performing teams through both onshore and offshore hiring support.
raw.description:
HireHawk is a fast-growing staffing and recruitment solutions company helping businesses build high-performing teams through both onshore and offshore hiring support. We partner with companies across multiple industries to solve hiring challenges, improve recruiting efficiency, reduce operational friction, and connect them with rigorously vetted talent.

HireHawk goes beyond traditional staffing by supporting the full hiring infrastructure companies need to scale, including recruiting, talent sourcing, payroll coordination, compliance support, onboarding workflows, and ongoing workforce management.

About the Role

This is a hands-on outbound GTM and sales execution role for someone who can build, manage, and continuously improve a scalable outbound engine.

The Outbound GTM Lead will own the infrastructure, workflows, and day-to-day systems required to keep HireHawk’s SDR team operating at full capacity. This includes lead list creation, prospect segmentation, contact enrichment, Apollo workflows, call prioritization, CRM processes, SDR enablement, call review, outbound reporting, and multichannel campaign development.

The immediate priority for this role is to strengthen and scale HireHawk’s phone-based outbound motion by ensuring SDRs consistently have high-quality, relevant prospects to call, clear scripts and qualification criteria, structured follow-up processes, and actionable coaching based on call performance.

As the outbound engine matures, this role will also build and optimize additional outbound channels, including email and LinkedIn, to support or independently generate qualified opportunities.

This is not a pure marketing role and not a traditional Account Executive role. The focus is on building the systems, processes, messaging, and SDR execution required to generate more qualified meetings and create a predictable outbound pipeline.

The Outbound GTM Lead will work closely with SDRs, sales leadership, and account management to ensure HireHawk’s outbound motion is structured, measurable, repeatable, scalable, and aligned with our staffing and recruitment services.

Responsibilities:

Outbound Infrastructure & List Building

  • Build, optimize, and manage HireHawk’s outbound infrastructure across Apollo, CRM systems, sales engagement tools, data enrichment platforms, and reporting systems.
  • Own lead list creation, prospect segmentation, contact enrichment, phone-number validation, sequence setup, and outbound campaign execution.
  • Develop high-quality prospect lists segmented by ICP, industry, buyer persona, geography, company size, hiring activity, hiring signals, and staffing need.
  • Ensure SDRs consistently have sufficient volumes of high-quality, phone-ready prospects to maintain strong daily calling activity.
  • Build repeatable systems for sourcing, enriching, validating, prioritizing, and routing leads to SDRs.
  • Continuously improve list quality based on connect rates, conversation quality, meeting conversion, and SDR feedback.
  • Identify and test new prospecting signals, data sources, and enrichment methods that improve outbound performance.

SDR Enablement & Call Performance

  • Partner closely with SDRs to improve daily outbound execution, call prioritization, productivity, follow-up discipline, and qualified meeting conversion.
  • Regularly review SDR call recordings and live call performance to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Provide actionable feedback and coaching on call openings, value propositions, qualification, objection handling, follow-up, and meeting conversion.
  • Develop and continuously improve cold-call scripts, talk tracks, objection-handling frameworks, and follow-up cadences.
  • Track recurring objections and market feedback and use those insights to improve targeting, messaging, scripts, and campaign strategy.
  • Help establish realistic activity and conversion benchmarks for SDR performance.
  • Build repeatable SDR playbooks, SOPs, workflows, training materials, and call-review processes.

Outbound Strategy & Multichannel Growth

  • Build and optimize outbound workflows across cold calling, email, LinkedIn, and CRM-based follow-up.
  • Prioritize channels based on measurable business impact rather than activity alone.
  • Initially focus on strengthening HireHawk’s phone-based outbound engine before scaling additional outbound channels.
  • Develop email and LinkedIn outbound programs once the core SDR calling process is operating effectively.
  • Determine when email and LinkedIn should function as follow-up and air-cover channels versus independent lead-generation channels.
  • Develop persona-specific and industry-specific messaging based on buyer pain points, market feedback, and campaign performance.
  • Run structured outbound experiments across ICPs, messaging, channels, call scripts, and hiring signals.

Analytics, Reporting & Process Improvement

Analyze SDR activity and outbound campaign performance across:

  • dials
  • connect rates
  • conversations
  • positive conversations
  • meetings booked
  • show rates
  • qualified meetings
  • qualified opportunities
  • conversion rates
  • performance by list, persona, industry, and campaign
  • Identify where outbound conversion is breaking down across list quality, targeting, messaging, call execution, follow-up, or qualification.
  • Build and maintain dashboards that make outbound performance clear and actionable.
  • Use performance data to continuously improve lists, scripts, workflows, SDR execution, and campaign strategy.
  • Maintain CRM hygiene, accurate lead stages, follow-up tasks, campaign attribution, and reporting discipline.
  • Reduce unnecessary manual work through automation while maintaining high data quality and strong SDR execution.

Requirements

  • Previous experience in a staffing agency, recruitment firm, RPO, talent acquisition company, HR services business, or workforce solutions company.
  • Strong hands-on experience building and managing outbound prospecting workflows using Apollo or similar sales intelligence and engagement platforms.
  • Demonstrated experience creating, enriching, validating, segmenting, and prioritizing outbound prospect lists.
  • Strong understanding of outbound cold calling, SDR workflows, call prioritization, prospecting sequences, follow-up cadences, and qualified meeting generation.
  • Experience working directly with SDRs or BDRs and improving their performance through call review, coaching, scripts, objection handling, and process development.
  • Ability to analyze outbound funnel performance and identify whether problems are caused by targeting, list quality, messaging, call execution, follow-up, or qualification.
  • Experience building or improving outbound sales systems and processes from the ground up.
  • Experience creating multichannel outbound campaigns across phone, email, LinkedIn, and CRM-based follow-up.
  • Strong understanding of staffing and recruitment buyer personas, pain points, objections, and sales motions.
  • Experience creating outbound messaging, cold-call scripts, email copy, LinkedIn messaging, and objection-handling frameworks.
  • Experience using AI and automation tools to improve list quality, prospect research, hiring-signal identification, segmentation, personalization, campaign development, and workflow efficiency.
  • Strong analytical and operational mindset with the ability to translate outbound performance data into practical improvements.
  • Highly organized, process-driven, and comfortable operating independently in a fast-paced startup environment.
  • Comfortable joining live sales calls, listening to SDR recordings, reviewing call notes, and providing direct performance feedback.
  • Comfortable being hands-on with execution rather than operating only at a strategy or management level.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with HubSpot, Salesforce, Outreach, Salesloft, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Clay, Instantly, Smartlead, Zapier, Make, or similar GTM tools.
  • Experience managing or supporting high-volume cold-calling environments.
  • Familiarity with power dialers, parallel dialing, call analytics, and SDR productivity tools.
  • Experience developing outbound motions targeting U.S.-based SMBs and mid-market companies.
  • Experience building outbound systems in a startup or high-growth environment with limited resources.
  • Experience improving outbound performance without significantly increasing SDR headcount.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted lead research, enrichment, segmentation, call analysis, and messaging workflows.

What success looks like:

Within the first 30–60 days:

  • SDRs consistently have enough high-quality, phone-ready prospects to maintain strong daily outbound activity.
  • Prospecting and list-building workflows are structured, repeatable, and increasingly automated.
  • Call scripts, objection handling, qualification criteria, and follow-up processes are clearly documented and actively improving.
  • SDR calls are reviewed regularly and coaching is tied to measurable performance data.
  • Outbound reporting clearly identifies where conversion is succeeding or breaking down.

Within the first 90 days:

  • HireHawk has a repeatable and scalable phone-first outbound system.
  • Manual list-building requirements have been significantly reduced.
  • SDR productivity and qualified meeting generation have improved.
  • Clear outbound playbooks and SOPs are in place.
  • Email and LinkedIn campaigns are being tested and scaled based on their ability to support or independently generate qualified opportunities.
  • The outbound engine is structured well enough to support additional SDR headcount without creating operational bottlenecks.
