raw.title: Managed Services Operations Lead - FinOps
raw.excerpt: AHEAD builds platforms for digital business.  By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.
raw.description:
AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.
At AHEAD, we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and heard. We create spaces to empower everyone to speak up, make change, and drive the culture at AHEAD.
We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individual's race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived.
We embrace all candidates that will contribute to the diversification and enrichment of ideas and perspectives at AHEAD.

The Managed Services Operations Lead, FinOps is the senior technical authority for AHEAD’s Cloud FinOps service, serving as thought leader and subject matter expert for clients, partners, and internal delivery teams. The role leads the development, design, and implementation of FinOps solutions across AWS, Azure, and GCP, and is accountable for the technical quality, consistency, and maturity of FinOps delivery across the managed services client portfolio.

Operating as a principal-level practitioner, this role owns the most complex client scenarios, serves as the primary technical escalation point for Cloud FinOps Engineers, and sets the standards, data models, automation, and reusable assets that the practice delivers against. The role also defines and drives the AI and automation roadmap for the FinOps practice, translating advanced analytics and machine learning capabilities into productized, explainable, and trusted service offerings. This is an individual contributor role that provides technical leadership, mentorship, and coordination across delivery resources without direct personnel-management responsibility.

The role requires a strategic mindset, mature executive communication skills, and commercial awareness, engaging client senior leadership, finance and procurement stakeholders, service and process owners, AHEAD service leadership, and sales teams directly. The role is performed remotely within the United States and includes up to 15 percent domestic travel, along with occasional after-hours or weekend support during major incidents, reporting deadlines, approved change windows, or other activities required by contracted service commitments.

Duties / Responsibilities

    Technical Leadership and Solution Design

    • Serve as the primary technical escalation point for Cloud FinOps Engineers supporting client engagements, resolving the most complex technical and financial analysis scenarios.
    • Act as principal engineer for high-complexity client situations requiring advanced cloud engineering, financial modeling, and cross-domain judgment.
    • Lead the development, design, and implementation of complex, mission-critical, enterprise-grade FinOps solutions, including AI-enabled capabilities where they deliver measurable client value.
    • Ensure FinOps services and deliverables are provided on time and at the highest quality standards while meeting or exceeding client expectations and contracted service commitments.
    • Develop and maintain technical roadmaps and innovation plans for supported FinOps solutions and services.
    • Establish project estimates and plans, identify risks and mitigations, and oversee the development and delivery of technical FinOps solutions.
    • Provide technical leadership and coordinate technical delivery resources across skillsets, including cross-practice work and deliverables, without direct personnel-management responsibility.
    • Provide credible time and effort estimates based on available information, and initiate and author project change requests when additional work is identified beyond agreed scope.

    Cloud Cost Analysis and Optimization

    • Lead deep-dive investigations into cloud spend drivers, billing anomalies, optimization opportunities, and cost visibility gaps across AWS, Azure, and GCP using native tooling and approved third-party FinOps platforms.
    • Define the methodology by which the practice identifies, quantifies, prioritizes, and drives optimization opportunities including rightsizing, idle resource cleanup, storage and data transfer optimization, licensing alignment, and scheduling strategies.
    • Own the framework for tracking optimization opportunities through identified, recommended, approved, implemented, and realized states, ensuring financial outcomes are validated and unrealized savings are not double-counted or misattributed.
    • Set the approach for cost visibility and allocation in containerized and Kubernetes workloads, including shared cluster cost distribution, namespace and label-based allocation, and idle capacity analysis.
    • Lead analysis and optimization of AI and GPU-related spend, including accelerated compute utilization, model training and inference costs, and consumption of managed AI and machine learning services.
    • Extend cost analysis and governance to SaaS, software licensing, and marketplace spend where these fall within the agreed scope of the engagement.
    • Define and oversee best-practices reviews that combine cost analysis with operational excellence analysis, using cloud-native and approved AHEAD tooling.

    Allocation, Unit Economics, and Reporting Architecture

    • Lead the design and implementation of scalable approaches for cost allocation, tagging strategy, showback, chargeback, budgeting, forecasting, and optimization across Azure, AWS, and GCP.
    • Define unit economics and cost-per-unit metric frameworks that tie cloud spend to business drivers such as customers, transactions, environments, products, or workloads.
    • Own the architecture of dashboards, reports, budgets, forecasts, executive summaries, and recurring service review content, and set quality standards for what the practice produces.
    • Define data validation and reconciliation standards across billing exports, connectors, cost datasets, and reporting models to improve trust in reported values, including adoption of standardized billing data formats such as FOCUS.
    • Establish continuous tagging governance through cloud-native policy enforcement, policy-as-code, and automated remediation, refining coverage as untagged or non-compliant resources are identified.
    • Set standards for client-facing FinOps tooling and portals, ensuring predictive analytics, multi-account views, and resource, configuration, and environment change reporting remain current and accurate.

    Commitment and Rate Strategy

    • Own the commitment strategy across the client portfolio, including reserved capacity and savings plan modeling, purchase governance, coverage and utilization targets, expiration and renewal planning, and savings realization tracking.
    • Lead support of enterprise agreement, private pricing, and committed-spend discussions by providing consumption analysis, commitment scenarios, and drawdown forecasts to client and AHEAD stakeholders.
    • Approve or review commitment recommendations produced by the team before they are presented to clients, ensuring financial assumptions and risk exposure are sound.

    Client Advisory, Growth, and Communication

    • Build and maintain strong client relationships, drive business growth, and identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling FinOps and adjacent AHEAD services.
    • Collaborate with clients to understand their technical, operational, and financial challenges and develop tailored FinOps solutions to address their needs.
    • Create and present solution designs, options, ideas, and innovations to clients’ senior leadership teams, and help client leadership set strategic direction beyond individual tactics.
    • Advise clients on FinOps best practices, governance models, operating models, and maturity improvements, including organizational adoption approaches such as crawl-walk-run.
    • Develop high-quality deliverables and presentations for client engineering teams, finance and procurement stakeholders, and senior leaders, including both technical and non-technical documentation.
    • Lead recurring client advisory and service review discussions covering cost and billing changes, optimization progress, roadmap items, migration candidates, and feedback on AHEAD’s service delivery performance.
    • Partner with CloudOps, DevOps, platform, application, finance, procurement, and client stakeholders to support implementation of recommendations and validate realized outcomes.
    • Maintain timely ticket updates, work documentation, meeting follow-ups, and internal and customer communications in accordance with service delivery expectations.
    • Support pre-sales, solutioning, scoping, positioning, and service maturation efforts by providing subject matter expertise, effort input, and delivery perspective, and identify and escalate new client opportunities.

    AI, Automation, and Practice Engineering

    • Define and drive the AI and automation roadmap for the FinOps practice, including use cases such as anomaly detection, rightsizing recommendations, commitment optimization, and intelligent budgeting and forecasting.
    • Evaluate and productize capabilities from FinOps platforms and cloud-native machine learning services into standard AHEAD offerings, including build-versus-buy recommendations and platform selection guidance.
    • Define the data quality, tagging, and metadata standards required for reliable AI-driven insights and automation of FinOps workflows.
    • Establish processes for monitoring and tuning models used for forecasting, anomaly detection, and optimization, ensuring transparency, explainability, and stakeholder trust in the outputs.
    • Collaborate with AHEAD’s AI, machine learning, and platform engineering teams to co-innovate joint FinOps solutions and reference architectures.
    • Build and oversee queries, data transformations, and automation using SQL and scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, or Bash, including event-driven and API-based integrations across FinOps platforms, ITSM tools, and cloud-native services.
    • Direct the integration of third-party tools, billing data sources, and reporting platforms into approved FinOps tooling and governance structures, including onboarding of new clients, accounts, subscriptions, and projects.
    • Oversee execution of approved remediation activities, including workload resizing, workload deletion, and commitment implementation, ensuring client change-control procedures and permission models are followed.

    Mentorship and Practice Development

    • Provide mentorship, coaching, and professional development opportunities to Cloud FinOps Engineers and other team members, empowering them to grow and excel in their roles.
    • Review team deliverables and analyses for technical accuracy, financial soundness, and presentation quality, elevating team capability and consistency.
    • Develop and maintain standards, procedures, data models, playbooks, work instructions, automation, and reusable assets that improve the maturity, consistency, and scalability of the FinOps practice.
    • Build team fluency in AI-assisted and automated workflows so engineers and analysts apply these tools effectively and with appropriate judgment in daily delivery.
    • Actively lead collaboration within AHEAD’s technical communities and influence team members, the broader internal organization, and external customers to adopt new concepts, best practices, and approaches.
    • Partner with Delivery Managers and service leadership to identify delivery risks, technical gaps, resourcing needs, and improvement opportunities across the FinOps practice.
    • Monitor delivery hours against contracted monthly allocations across the portfolio, flagging utilization trends and coordinating any approved overage or rescoping through the change-request process.
    • Serve as a reliable resource for thought leadership content, workshops, industry conferences, and webinars representing the practice.
    • Deliver FinOps and tooling education and training for client teams to build internal cost-management capability, in addition to mentoring within the AHEAD practice.

General

    • Maintain availability during the assigned team’s standard business hours, with reasonable flexibility to accommodate recurring client meetings and service reviews across United States time zones.
    • Participate in and provide senior escalation support for the team’s on-call or escalation rotation where applicable to the assigned account portfolio.
    • Stay current on cloud pricing models, FinOps best practices, emerging AI and analytics capabilities, and service provider roadmaps while helping refine how AHEAD delivers cloud cost optimization and advisory services.
    • Provide occasional after-hours support for client meetings, reporting deadlines, change windows, critical incidents, or urgent cost-related issues when required.
    • Maintain relevant professional and cloud certifications consistent with role, practice, and individual development requirements, and meet or exceed individual goal objectives.
    • Other job duties as assigned.

Education and Experience

    Minimum Required –

    • Bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, finance, business, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and practical experience.
    • 10+ years of information technology experience, including 5+ years focused on FinOps, cloud cost management, cloud governance, or related cloud engineering.
    • 5+ years in a customer-facing, stakeholder-facing, consulting, or service delivery role with responsibility for presenting findings, solution designs, and recommendations to technical, financial, and executive audiences.
    • 2+ years using and administering FinOps and cloud management platforms such as Harness CCM, Cloudability, CloudHealth, CloudZero, native cloud cost management tools, or similar solutions.
    • Demonstrated experience designing, deploying, or operating large-scale, multi-account, multi-subscription, or enterprise cloud environments.
    • Subject matter expertise in at least one major public cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP) with working depth in a second; strong Azure or AWS experience preferred.
    • Demonstrated experience leading technical delivery, serving as an escalation point, and reviewing the work of other engineers for quality and consistency.
    • Proficiency in SQL and at least one scripting language such as Python, PowerShell, or Bash, sufficient to build and maintain cost data transformations, automation, and recurring reporting.
    • Multiple relevant certifications such as FinOps Certified Practitioner, FinOps Certified Professional, AWS Solutions Architect, Microsoft Azure Administrator, Azure Solutions Architect, Google Cloud certifications, or similar.
    • Demonstrated experience integrating third-party tools, billing data sources, and reporting platforms.
    • Strong analytical, financial modeling, spreadsheet, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a shared services or multi-client environment.
    • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.
    • Ability to successfully complete AHEAD and client-required background screening; certain client environments may require additional vetting or clearance.

Preferred Experience

    Experience working in a managed services, consulting, or outsourced service delivery environment.
    • Experience building or maturing a FinOps practice, service offering, or center of excellence, including standards, playbooks, and reusable assets.
    • Hands-on experience with cloud data and analytics platforms such as Snowflake, BigQuery, or Databricks for aggregating and analyzing cloud cost and usage data.
    • Familiarity with machine learning and advanced analytics concepts such as time-series forecasting, anomaly detection, and clustering, and how they apply to cloud cost optimization and capacity planning.
    • Experience integrating FinOps platforms with automation, orchestration, and AI services to build end-to-end workflows and recommendations.
    • Experience with policy-as-code and cloud governance tooling such as Terraform with Sentinel, Open Policy Agent, Azure Policy, or AWS Config to operationalize FinOps guardrails.
    • Experience with forecasting, budgeting, allocation methodologies, showback or chargeback models, commitment planning, and savings realization tracking.
    • Familiarity with the FinOps Framework and with standardized billing data formats such as FOCUS.
    • Experience with Kubernetes or container cost allocation, and with AI or GPU cost management.
    • Experience with reporting and visualization platforms such as Power BI or Tableau.
    • Familiarity with ticketing and workflow platforms such as ServiceNow, Jira, or similar tools.
    • Experience contributing to pre-sales activities, including scoping, positioning, proposal support, and technology adoption.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

    Expert-level understanding of cloud billing constructs including on-demand usage, reserved capacity, savings plans or commitments, amortization, allocation methods, and forecasting drivers.
    • Expert-level experience analyzing cloud billing data, usage trends, tagging compliance, and optimization opportunities across Azure, AWS, and GCP.
    • Hands-on experience designing and implementing FinOps capabilities around cost visibility, allocation, governance, optimization, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting.
    • Experience with enterprise cloud platforms and services across compute, storage, networking, databases, containers, security, and identity, with the ability to connect technical design decisions to financial outcomes.
    • Knowledge of enterprise FinOps principles including crawl-walk-run adoption models, cloud-native cost optimization strategies, governance frameworks, infrastructure as code, and cloud operating models.
    • Working knowledge of unit economics concepts and the ability to connect infrastructure consumption to business and product metrics.
    • Understanding of cost behavior in containerized, serverless, data platform, and accelerated computing environments.
    • Understanding of performance, scaling, and functional characteristics of cloud and open-source technologies, with the ability to recommend standard design patterns and best practices.
    • Experience driving organizational adoption of transformational initiatives such as FinOps, cloud governance, cost accountability, showback, chargeback, and operational maturity improvement.

raw.description:
The bright side of mortgages

nesto is Canada’s leading digital residential mortgage lender, offering Canadians the lowest rates from the get-go — with total transparency and no haggling.

About Us

As Canada's pioneer in online mortgage lending, nesto is transforming the way Canadians finance their homes. Our mission is to offer a positive, empowering, and transparent property financing experience, simplified from start to finish.

Borrowers benefit from rates that are often lower than those offered by the big banks, along with an exceptional end-to-end mortgage experience powered by best-in-class AI technology. Fast, simple, and fully digital, nesto has been recognized as CLA Lender of the Year for three consecutive years. That's the bright side of mortgages.

Nesto Group

Nesto Group is Canada's leading provider of mortgage technology and financing solutions, with more than CAD $80 billion in residential and commercial mortgages under administration. Trusted by many of the country's leading financial institutions, we combine over 50 years of mortgage expertise with proprietary cloud and AI technology to transform the future of lending.

Powered by our proprietary cloud and AI technology, nesto has become one of Canada's fastest-growing mortgage lenders, gaining market share across direct-to-consumer (D2C) residential lending, the broker channel, and multi-family commercial lending. Recognized as one of Deloitte's Fast 50 companies for three consecutive years, we continue to push the industry forward through innovation, technology, and customer-focused solutions.

Operating through our family of brands—CMLS, nesto, and Nesto Cloud—our mission is to build Canada's mortgage ecosystem of the future and create a true Canadian champion in lending technology and financial services. Learn more at:

Life at nesto

At nesto, we're passionate about challenging the status quo and building a better mortgage experience and saving money on their mortgages for Canadians. We foster a culture of collaboration, transparency, and creativity where every team member is empowered to take ownership, make an impact, and grow. If you're looking to solve meaningful problems alongside ambitious, supportive teammates, you'll feel right at home here.

About the team

You’ll be joining the Servicing stream, the product area responsible for the post-funding mortgage journey. This includes borrower self-serve experiences, agent-facing servicing tools, payment and prepayment workflows, renewals, payouts, statements, fees, exceptions management, and core servicing operations.

This is a Senior Product Manager role where part of your mandate is to help shape and own a specific servicing substream. You’ll work closely with the stream lead to define the boundaries of your focus area based on your strengths, the team’s needs, and the largest opportunities to improve the borrower and agent experience.

Your closest collaborators will include engineering teams building on Nesto Cloud, servicing operations experts who manage these workflows every day, and internal stakeholders across compliance, finance, contact centre, and growth operations.

What you’ll be doing

  • Act as one of the primary servicing subject matter experts for your substream, with a deep understanding of end-to-end servicing processes, operational realities, and regulatory requirements.
  • Define and own the product vision, roadmap, and prioritization for your area, ensuring it reflects real servicing needs, operational efficiency goals, risk controls, and compliance considerations.
  • Identify and assess the impact of new servicing features, policy changes, regulatory updates, and workflow improvements to help shape product direction and support strategic decisions.
  • Work closely with engineering, design, QA, operations, compliance, and support teams to validate solutions and ensure they align with servicing best practices and industry standards.
  • Support backlog refinement by prioritizing servicing-related epics and stories, balancing borrower experience, agent efficiency, technical feasibility, and business value.
  • Participate in release planning, UAT, and launch readiness to ensure servicing use cases are fully supported, edge cases are addressed, and downstream impacts are understood.
  • Conduct research on servicing trends, mortgage regulations, servicing technologies, and competitor approaches, bringing insights that inform product evolution.
  • Create and maintain clear documentation of servicing workflows, requirements, scenarios, decision logic, and system behaviours to support cross-functional teams.
  • Act as the go-to expert for your servicing workflows, supporting issue triage, answering questions, and helping the team deliver exceptional servicing experiences across lending products.

AI-augmented ways of working

  • Actively use AI tools such as Cursor, Claude, Figma AI, Gemini, and others to accelerate your PM workflow from discovery through delivery, including synthesis, prototyping, documentation, and measurement.
  • Move quickly to test hypotheses using the tools available. Build rough prototypes, pressure-test ideas, and use fast experiments to get to answers sooner.
  • Stay close to the work. The best people here do not hand things off and wait. They use every tool available to move the work forward.
  • Stay ahead of how AI is reshaping mortgage servicing and bring informed recommendations into the roadmap.
  • Share what you learn so your way of working improves the team around you.

Who we’re looking for

  • 5–7+ years of hands-on product management experience, ideally with exposure to mortgage servicing, lending operations, or a closely adjacent regulated financial services environment.
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end servicing functions, including payments, prepayments, renewals, payouts, fees, statements, borrower communications, and exception handling.
  • Knowledge of regulatory and compliance requirements related to mortgage servicing and consumer lending, including provincial regulations, OSFI guidelines, insurance considerations, and reporting obligations.
  • Experience working with servicing platforms, loan management systems, or lending technology, with the ability to translate operational needs into clear product requirements.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across product, engineering, design, operations, compliance, QA, and support teams.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to anticipate downstream impacts, identify edge cases, and improve complex servicing workflows.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex servicing concepts clearly to non-experts in Product and Engineering.
  • Proven, active fluency with AI tools across discovery, testing, documentation, analysis, and measurement. We will ask you specifically how you use them.

Preferred but not required

  • Experience with other lending products such as HELOC, personal loans, private lending, reverse mortgages, or construction financing.
  • Familiarity with borrower-facing and agent-facing servicing journeys, including the relationship between self-serve and assisted support.
  • Exposure to AI or ML-assisted servicing operations, intelligent routing, document intelligence, or workflow automation in a financial services context.

How we get to know each other

  • Recruiter Screen – 30 minutes
  • Discovery Call with Director of Product – 30 minutes
  • Take-home Assignment followed by Presentation and Q&A – 60 minutes
  • Final Stakeholder Interview – 45 minutes
  • Background and Reference Checks + Offer

    • Why You'll Love Working Here

    We believe great people do their best work when they're supported professionally, personally, and financially. That's why we offer a comprehensive rewards package designed to help you thrive at every stage of your career.
    Competitive Rewards — Competitive compensation, performance incentives (where applicable), and recognition for your contributions.

    Health & Wellness — Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, Health & Wellness Spending Accounts (where applicable), telemedicine, Employee Assistance Programs, and mental health support for you and your family.

    Time to Recharge — Generous vacation (4 weeks), floater days, and statutory holidays to help you recharge.

    Planning for the Future — RRSP matching to support your long-term financial wellbeing.

    Family Support — Enhanced maternity and parental leave top-up programs.

    Learning & Growth — Education assistance, mentorship, training, and opportunities to build your career across Nesto Group.

    Tools for Success — Modern technology, collaborative teams, and the resources you need to do your best work.

    Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

    At Nesto Group, we believe diverse perspectives make us stronger. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, supported, and empowered to succeed.

    We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, including Indigenous Peoples (First Nations, Inuit, and Métis), persons with disabilities, members of racialized communities, women, and members of the 2SLGBTQIA+ community.

    If you require accommodation during any stage of the recruitment process, we are committed to working with you to meet your needs.

raw.description:
About the job

Mercor connects elite creative and technical talent with leading AI research labs. Headquartered in San Francisco, our investors include Benchmark, General Catalyst, Peter Thiel, Adam D'Angelo, Larry Summers, and Jack Dorsey.

Position: PDF Annotation & Transcription Experts – Bengali
Type:Contract
Compensation:$13/hour
Location:Remote

Role Responsibilities

  • Source documents: find a publicly accessible Bengali PDF in an assigned document type, containing at least one multimodal element (images, tables, diagrams, or handwriting), and record where you obtained it.
  • Annotate structure: identify and bound every meaningful region of the page - document title, section heading, paragraph, list, table, figure, diagram, caption, formula, question, answer field - and assign each a component type and a reading-order index.
  • Record relationships: link each region to the figure or table it belongs to through a parent component identifier.
  • Transcribe faithfully: reproduce all text exactly as it appears in Bengali script, including handwritten content, flagging any region where the source is not legible.
  • Capture page metadata: language, document type, source, page dimensions, and flags for tables, formulas, and handwriting.
  • Review a colleague's work: every task is reviewed end to end by a second Bengali expert, and experienced annotators take on that review.

Qualifications

Must-Have

  • Native Bengali speaker with full command of the script, its diacritics, and its conjunct forms.
  • Experience with documents: annotation, transcription, translation, localization, subtitling, proofreading, journalism, or regional-language data review.
  • Exact character-level accuracy; a single wrong diacritic is a defect.
  • Systematic application of a taxonomy across hundreds of pages.
  • Comfort with unfamiliar layouts: multi-column newspapers, exam papers, handwritten forms.

Preferred

  • Regional-language AI data: annotation, labeling, grading, or bilingual evaluation for training datasets.
  • Transcription and localization: MTPE, subtitling, bilingual QA, OCR correction or post-editing.
  • Document production: typesetting, copy-editing, proofreading, or digitization of Bengali-language material.
  • Script and encoding: Unicode normalization, Bengali input methods, numeral-form and character-form accuracy.

Application Process (Takes 20–30 mins to complete)

  • Upload resume
  • AI interview based on your resume
  • Submit form

  • For any help or support, reach out to:

raw.description:
Our client, a dynamic Amazon FBA business with a global presence, is seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Demand Planning and Inventory Optimization Manager to join its Supply Chain Department. This role will lead efforts in forecasting demand, managing inventory levels, and optimizing stock for their entire catalog of products. As a key part of the Supply Chain team, this individual will ensure that the company maintains optimal stock levels while balancing cost efficiencies and operational requirements.

About the company:

The company is specialised on developing and upscaling Amazon-based brands across the USA, Canada, Europe, and the UK. With deep expertise in eCommerce and Amazon FBA, the company excels in buying, developing, and scaling brands to their fullest potential. The company navigates the complexities of international markets and high-performance marketing, ensuring seamless scalability and growth.

The company's portfolio includes several Amazon brands, primarily in the home and kitchen category, as well as some electronics. Its international team of 17 world-class talents manages all operations today.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Demand Planning: Analyze historical sales data, current product trends, and market insights to accurately forecast demand for all products.
  • Inventory Management: Calculate and manage optimal inventory levels to ensure product availability while minimizing excess stock and associated costs.
  • Order Management: Generate purchase orders for replenishment based on forecasted demand and stock levels, collaborating with suppliers to ensure timely deliveries.
  • Stock Control & Optimization: Monitor and optimize stock levels across the catalog, ensuring products are always available in the required quantities and minimizing overstock.
  • Analytics & Reporting: Provide regular reports on demand forecasts, stock status, and key performance indicators (KPIs). Use advanced analytics to recommend inventory adjustments and supply chain improvements.

You will be focused on the long-term account management of top-tier customers and strategically drive increased sales over short-term opportunities by cooperating with internal and external partners. Your covered business portfolio will contain all FARO Creaform solutions including hardware systems, SW platforms, and automated solutions.

Our Account Manager works out of a home office and will ideally be based around the North Carolina area. This position has the potential to earn a total compensation package (salary + variable) $150,000.

How you will make a difference @ FARO CREAFORM:

  • Demonstrate FARO Creaform technology to interested and / or potential customers;
  • Participation in trade shows, technical events, open-house, sales meetings and other sales events.
  • Ensure steady and organized follow-up on sales opportunities through emails, phone calls, etc. to ensure the expected level of sales and a sales cycle as compact as possible by using the CRM system.
  • Clearly identify and communicate all customer needs and specifications for the Sales Operations to prepare the quote
  • Act as point of contact and provide technical support and regular follow-ups to potential customers during the evaluation period.
  • Report progress of all ongoing sales activities on a weekly basis during team opportunity-review, provide sales forecast, and participate to forecast review meetings.
  • Develop a large network of contacts and clients within the designated territory in teamwork with the Sales Manager.
  • Professional management of existing customers over the entire product life cycle including the identification of further business opportunities.
  • Demonstrated ability and willingness to use AI tools to improve productivity, decision-making, work quality, and to reduce costs. The successful candidate must be able to identify appropriate AI use cases and critically evaluate AI-generated outputs.
  • Protect the profit margins of FARO Creaform by organizing efficient travel and adding value; rather than discounting.

You have:

  • Degree in mechanical engineering or relevant technical field.
  • 1-5 years of experience in sales in a manufacturing/technological environment.
  • Have a strong interest in technology and learning about technological products.
  • Have experience in a technical field, sales, and/or customer support.
  • This position requires the ability to maintain a valid U.S. driver’s license and meet the company’s driving eligibility requirements, with or without reasonable accommodation.
  • This position requires the ability to safely lift, move, or position materials weighing up to 90 pounds on an occasional basis, with or without reasonable accommodation.
  • Ability to travel up to 50% of the time, including overnight stays for client meetings and site visits.
  • Demonstrated ability and willingness to use AI tools to improve productivity, decision-making, work quality, and to reduce costs. The successful candidate must be able to identify appropriate AI use cases and critically evaluate AI-generated outputs.

What FARO CREAFORM can offer you:

FARO CREAFORM has excellent benefits for you and your family. We not only care for our employees but also for their immediate family members. We believe in a balanced work life and have developed programs and benefits plans to support that ethic, such as:

  • A competitive paid time off bank and paid holidays
  • Medical, dental, life and AD&D insurance plans.
  • Pre-tax flex spending accounts for medical and dependent care.
  • 401K with employer match.
  • Tuition reimbursement and training opportunities.
  • Wellness fairs.
  • Frequent lunch and learns to help educate employees about issues affecting their lives.
  • Other employee events.

We are a drug-free workplace with pre-employment drug screening.

Description

TripleTen is a service that empowers individuals, regardless of their prior experience, to embark on the exciting and challenging journey of mastering tech professions.

Our bootcamps focus on training students in software engineering, data science, business intelligence analytics, and QA engineering in a feasible and accessible way, ultimately leading them to thrive in a new career.

Our mission is to ensure that every student has the opportunity to successfully master a new profession, find their purpose, and become a valuable member of the tech industry.

TripleTen is a remote first organization mirroring our students who complete our bootcamps in a remote environment.

We are looking for a proactive, detail-oriented Marketing Manager to own and drive a portfolio of marketing projects, from scoping through launch and results tracking. This role collaborates closely with our Marketing, Content, and Product teams to identify opportunities, run initiatives end-to-end, and turn insights into measurable results.

The best candidates for this position combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution, are comfortable managing several projects at once, and know how to turn a messy problem into a clear plan.

What you will do

  • Own and drive multiple marketing projects end-to-end, from scoping to launch to results tracking.
  • Analyze market and audience feedback, turning insights into actionable marketing initiatives.
  • Develop and execute content and community strategies in collaboration with internal teams and external agencies.
  • Establish and grow brand presence across social media, online communities, and other digital channels.
  • Build guidelines and playbooks to support consistent brand messaging across channels.
  • Coordinate with internal teams to resolve complex, cross-functional issues.
  • Track project performance and report on key metrics to leadership.
  • Identify and act on opportunities to improve brand visibility and audience engagement.
  • Set up and manage engagement processes for key audience segments (students, graduates, alumni, etc.).
  • Scout, test, and scale new channels and platforms to reach and grow our audience.

Requirements

You're a strong, hands-on marketing generalist who loves building things yourself, not just managing others, with:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience running marketing projects end-to-end.
  • Strong background working with consumer-facing brands.
  • Excellent English communication skills for global audience engagement.
  • Analytical mindset with ability to measure and optimize project and campaign metrics.
  • Experience across several marketing disciplines: content, social media, and community.
  • Strategic thinking combined with tactical execution capabilities.
  • Hands-on experience with AI in at least one area — building products, funnels, designs, copywriting workflows, or agents.
  • Proven ability to manage sensitive or public-facing situations effectively.

Bonus points for:

  • Experience in education technology or similar consumer services.
  • Content creation and digital marketing skills.
  • Crisis communication experience.

What we can offer you

  • Base compensation of $3000/month plus annual bonus.
  • Fully remote collaboration.
  • High autonomy to explore, test, and improve marketing processes.
  • Work alongside an experienced, global marketing team.
  • Room to grow your scope as projects prove out.

raw.excerpt: Our MissionAt Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life.
raw.description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Summary

As a Transformation Programs Advisor, you will serve as a strategic advisory partner connecting client business objectives with enterprise security architectures. In this role, you will help enterprise organizations evaluate, quantify, and articulate the business and operational value of security transformation initiatives. You will work alongside customer executives and security leaders to model financial ROI, define target state security postures, and establish strategic roadmaps for modern identity and security architectures.

Core Responsibilities

Value Engineering & Financial Modeling

  • Business Case Development: Build quantitative financial models, business cases, and total cost of ownership (TCO) analyses to demonstrate the value of security modernization.

  • Risk & Value Assessment: Evaluate client current-state operational costs, administrative overhead, and security risk exposure to help executive stakeholders prioritize transformation investments.

  • Executive Roadmaps: Deliver strategic business cases and long-term transformation roadmaps tailored for complex enterprise organizations in regulated industries.

Strategic Advisory & Pre-Sales Engagement

  • Value-Driven Consulting: Partner with Sales and Technical Teams during early-stage customer engagements to align solution vision with client business drivers.

  • Executive Workshops: Lead interactive visioning sessions and executive workshops with C-suite stakeholders and security leaders to articulate the benefits of modernizing identity and access architectures.

  • Outcome-Focused Messaging: Frame customer discussions around business resilience, operational efficiency, and long-term risk reduction rather than tactical product feature sets.

Architectural Vision & Strategy

  • Target Architecture Alignment: Advise customer stakeholders on modern security principles, including Zero Trust frameworks, modern privilege management, and cloud-first security models.

  • Best Practice Standardization: Help refine repeatable consultative frameworks, templates, and engagement models to elevate advisory standards across strategic customer accounts.

  • Subject Matter Expertise: Serve as a consultative SME during strategic opportunity reviews, effectively communicating both business return and technical feasibility.

Stakeholder Alignment & Leadership

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product, Sales, and Customer Operations teams to align customer requirements with organizational strategy.

  • Executive Communication: Translate complex technical concepts into clear, executive-ready presentations tailored for non-technical leadership and board-level audiences.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in value engineering, management consulting, strategic pre-sales, security architecture, or enterprise transformation advisory.

  • Industry Knowledge: Demonstrated understanding of enterprise IT infrastructure, cybersecurity principles, identity management concepts, and risk management frameworks.

  • Financial Acumen: Strong capability in financial modeling, ROI/TCO calculation, and business case formulation for complex technical programs.

  • Communication: Exceptional presentation, whiteboard facilitation, and executive communication skills with proven ability to influence C-level decision-makers.

Preferred Certifications

  • Security & Governance: CISSP, CISM, or equivalent security certifications.

  • Cloud Architecture: AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or Google Professional Cloud Architect.

  • Process & Program Management: PMP, ITIL, or equivalent methodology credentials.

Compensation Disclosure

The compensation offered for this position will depend on qualifications, experience, and work location. For candidates who receive an offer at the posted level, the starting base salary (for non-sales roles) or base salary + commission target (for sales/com-missioned roles) is expected to be the annual range listed below. The offered compensation may also include restricted stock units and a bonus. A description of our employee benefits may be found here.

$160,000.00 - $220,000.00/yr

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at .

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

raw.description:
BridgePhase is a mission-focused technology company that designs, builds, secures, and operates modern digital solutions that drive national security, government efficiency, and mission success across the Federal Government. We empower agencies to achieve meaningful outcomes through high-performing software engineering, cloud, DevSecOps, cybersecurity, AI/ML, and platform modernization solutions delivered by collaborative teams focused on innovation, adaptability, and operational excellence. As a trusted partner, BridgePhase helps Federal organizations modernize critical systems, accelerate delivery, and achieve lasting mission impact.

Position Overview:

In this role, you will serve as the primary point of contact for NS2 Cloud Customers within Federal Accounts, including both DoD and Federal Civilian (Fed-CIV) agencies, focusing on S/4HANA RISE Private Cloud Edition (PCE).

You will be responsible for strategic and operational delivery leadership, driving end-to-end customer engagement from contract signature onwards - covering onboarding, service delivery execution, release and maintenance planning, governance and architecture oversight, and renewal strategy.

This role requires a comprehensive understanding of DoD and Federal RAMP (FedRAMP, IL2–IL6) regulations and compliance frameworks, ensuring cloud delivery models meet applicable federal cybersecurity and regulatory mandates

*This position requires access to customer data. Must be a U.S. citizen. Fully remote position.

Key Responsibilities:

Engagement & Relationship Management

  • Serve as the senior-level customer engagement lead and trusted advisor for Federal, DoD, and Fed-CIV clients.
  • Conduct regular executive and quarterly business reviews with customer leadership to evaluate service quality and business outcomes.
  • Deliver and interpret balanced scorecards and performance KPIs to ensure overall customer satisfaction and drive continuous improvement.
  • Translate Federal mission goals into aligned SAP NS2 cloud strategies and roadmaps, helping customers maximize the value and security of their SAP investments.
Delivery & Operations Management
  • Lead complex onboarding/transition projects in DoD and Fed-CIV regulated environments with an emphasis on compliance, security, and operational excellence.
  • Serve as the single point of contact for service and support requirements across NS2 Cloud Services.
  • Manage multi-domain service delivery according to defined scope, budget, and milestones, ensuring alignment with FedRAMP and DoD Impact Level (IL) standards.
  • Oversee incident management and escalation processes, collaborating with internal Mission Control Center (MCC) and Operations Control Center (OCC) teams.
  • Develop and enforce quality and compliance plans to maintain adherence to Federal security and operational standards.
  • Lead customer release and maintenance planning, including IT calendar management and version control to maintain regulated compliance posture.
Account & Business Management
  • Build senior executive relationships across customer stakeholder organizations, including procurement, program management, and security compliance teams.
  • Identify and develop upsell and service expansion opportunities across SAP NS2 cloud offerings, in collaboration with Sales and Solution teams.
  • Support renewals, contract extensions, and commercial change requests ensuring alignment with compliance and delivery goals.
  • Drive Cloud Application Services operating profit reviews and ensure service-level adherence and SLA management.
Education & Experience Requirements:
  • Bachelor’s Degree (or equivalent experience) in Business Administration, Computer Science, Technical Engineering, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of customer-facing program or delivery management experience, preferably within Federal, DoD, or Fed-CIV environments.
  • Deep understanding of DoD Cloud security models, FedRAMP compliance, and NIST frameworks.
  • Proven ability to lead delivery for multiple customers while maintaining high compliance and service quality standards.
  • Strong executive communication, relationship building, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Expertise in service delivery for SAP solutions, including S/4HANA, BTP, and SAC, with experience in Cloud Application and Technical Delivery.
  • Demonstrated adaptability and innovative mindset toward adopting new technologies, such as AI and automation, to optimize delivery performance and operations.
  • Experience with SAP or SAP NS2 preferred.
Desired Professional Training & Certification:
  • ITIL Foundation or higher certification preferred.
  • Working knowledge of SAP NS2 Cloud models, operating processes, and Federal compliance standards.
  • Familiarity with DoD IL2–IL6 certification levels, FedRAMP, DISA STIGs, and related regulatory frameworks highly desirable.

As with any dynamic technical environment, responsibilities will evolve based on mission needs. We are looking for individuals who are adaptable, proactive, and eager to take ownership of new challenges as they arise.

About Our Company:

BridgePhase was built around one simple belief: People who love where they work build better solutions. We bring top-tier engineering talent to the Government to support the nation's most critical work. Our people are not only technically exceptional, they're energized to deliver the engineering excellence, culture, and accountability our Government deserves. We thrive on building modern, secure, resilient solutions that accelerate mission outcomes, eliminate legacy barriers, and enable Government organizations to deliver faster and adapt smarter to meet today's demands and tomorrow's mission – without compromise.

Our Benefits:

At BridgePhase, we invest in our people with benefits that support your life, reward your impact, and reflect what matters most – both on the job and beyond it. Employee benefits include:

  • Competitive compensation that reflects your skills and impact
  • Multiple bonus programs rewarding performance, company growth, and employee referrals
  • Flexible PTO with 20 days to use when you need them
  • All federal holidays paid to help you truly recharge
  • 7 paid sick leave because health always comes first
  • 100% paid parental leave
  • 401(k) with 6% match and no vesting period
  • Top-tier medical, dental, and vision plans with low out-of-pocket costs
  • Short- and long-term disability and life insurance included
  • Pet insurance to support your four-legged family
  • Annual professional development budget for training, certifications, and conferences
  • Two paid community service days for causes that matter to you
  • Social pod budget to connect with teammates wherever you live

raw.title: Staff Data Scientist, Data Products
raw.excerpt: Do you want to empower organizations to build smarter compensation strategies while ensuring fair pay for all employees?
raw.description:
Do you want to empower organizations to build smarter compensation strategies while ensuring fair pay for all employees?

Syndio is the leading pay governance and compensation intelligence platform. We help organizations make better pay decisions at every stage of the compensation lifecycle, from leveling and offers to promotions and merit. Our platform gives HR, compensation, and finance leaders the data and decision support they need to govern pay fairly, compliantly, and with confidence. We partner with many of the world’s most recognized and respected enterprises, helping them implement leading-edge compensation solutions with expert guidance and analyzing pay for over 10 million employees across the world.

Join us in our mission to help companies make smarter pay decisions they can trust!

About the role

We are looking for a Staff Data Scientist, Data Products to serve as a senior analytical and product partner across Syndio's product and data-product portfolio. You will own measurement strategies for our product platform, translate usage and business data into product decisions, and help turn those signals — together with pay-equity, policy, job architecture, market, and workforce data — into customer-facing analytical products.

This is a high-autonomy, high-visibility staff role. You will lead ambiguous, cross-functional work from opportunity discovery through methodology, validation, production, and launch; partner with Product, Data Science, Engineering, Privacy, Legal, Sales, and Customer Success; and set standards for analytical rigor, interpretability, data quality, and responsible data use. The role is an individual contributor position with broad influence.

Why this job is exciting

Product Measurement & Decision Support

  • Own measurement strategies for Syndi's core user workflows — including offer endorsement, approval, and acceptance — defining events, metrics, and success criteria that guide product decisions.
  • Partner with engineering to design and validate event instrumentation for new features, ensuring tracking is accurate, consistent, and privacy-safe from the start.
  • Conduct deep-dive analyses into feature adoption, workflow completion, user engagement, customer outcomes, and operational patterns to surface actionable insights.
  • Build and maintain production-grade dashboards and self-serve reporting in Mixpanel, BigQuery, and BI tooling that give product teams and senior leaders visibility into product health.
  • Translate complex, ambiguous usage data into clear, prioritized recommendations for technical, product, and executive audiences.

Data Product Development

  • Define and lead analytical strategies for new compensation and workforce data products that make Syndio more valuable, differentiated, and difficult to replicate.
  • Identify high-value opportunities to combine Syndio's aggregated and anonymized first-party data with compensation market data, job-posting and skills data, and other third-party sources.
  • Develop diagnostics that measure compensation governance and execution health, including policy-versus-practice gaps, job-architecture health, governance adoption, strategic alignment, and overpayment risk.
  • Lead complex initiatives from early exploration and hypothesis formation through analytical validation, productionization, commercialization, and launch.
  • Evaluate whether proposed data products are analytically defensible, interpretable, commercially valuable, privacy-preserving, and responsible to use.
  • Contribute to the give-to-get data strategy by identifying which product and customer signals can strengthen Syndio's broader data assets over time.

Cross-functional Leadership & Standards

  • Serve as a senior analytical partner in product discovery, sprint planning, roadmap discussions, business reviews, and product planning cycles.
  • Partner with Data Science on experiment design, causal analysis, model evaluation, and measurement of model-assisted workflows.
  • Work with Customer Success and Sales to connect product usage and data-product insights to customer value, health, and renewal risk.
  • Establish and champion standards for event data, analytical quality, documentation, interpretability, privacy, and responsible data use.
  • Provide technical and analytical leadership to other practitioners, raise data literacy across the product organization, and build self-serve capability.

About you

  • 8+ years of experience in product analytics, data science, analytics engineering, or a closely related role, including substantial experience supporting software products and/or developing analytical products.
  • Proficiency with AI-assisted development tools and workflows, using them to accelerate analysis, prototyping, code generation, documentation, and data-product development while validating outputs and exercising sound judgment.
  • Familiarity with emerging AI and BI innovation — including natural-language interfaces, automated insights, semantic layers, and agentic workflows — and the ability to evaluate where these capabilities can improve analytical products and customer experiences.
  • A track record of setting direction and leading complex, cross-functional initiatives with significant product or business impact.
  • Deep proficiency in SQL and strong working proficiency with Python, R, or a comparable analytical language.
  • Advanced knowledge of statistical measurement, benchmarking, experimentation, data modeling, segmentation, data quality assessment, and analytical validation.
  • Experience designing event schemas, product measurement strategies, funnels, dashboards, and self-serve reporting using tools such as Mixpanel, Amplitude, Looker, Tableau, or equivalent.
  • Experience combining large, imperfect datasets into analytically defensible, interpretable, and commercially valuable products or insights.
  • Exceptional judgment and comfort operating in ambiguous, evolving problem spaces; able to determine when approximation is appropriate and when precision is required.
  • Ability to influence senior stakeholders, communicate complex methodologies clearly, and drive alignment across technical and non-technical audiences.

Extra Credit

  • Experience instrumenting or evaluating a GenAI-native product, including model-assisted workflows.
  • Deep familiarity with compensation, pay equity, workforce planning, labor-market data, job architecture, skills taxonomies, or people analytics.
  • Experience with compensation surveys, job-posting data, privacy-preserving analytics, or third-party data licensing and governance.
  • Familiarity with GDPR/CCPA and related privacy considerations for user-level event data and aggregated or anonymized customer data.

Why you'll love it here:

  • 💰 Competitive Compensation. For this role our salary is targeted at $180,000 -$205,000 per year. Final offer amounts are determined by factors such as experience and expertise. We take a geo neutral approach to compensation within the US, meaning that we pay based on job function and level, not location.
  • 🏆 Syndio Equity. So you can share in Syndio’s success.
  • 🏝 Flexible Vacation Policy. We encourage our team to recharge when they need to, plus paid sick & safe time, compassion leave, and voting leave.

The Executive Assistant will operate independently, exercise sound judgment, and maintain a high level of attention to detail as well as be able to work with a team of assistants to problem solve and share knowledge.
This role requires professionalism in working with senior executives, integrity in handling confidential information, and the ability to meet tight deadlines while supporting stakeholders across global teams.   • Learn about changing business needs and consider the impact on services provided.

What You'll Do

As a Senior Product Manager, Data Products, you'll lead the strategy and execution for our suite of data products serving RV, Powersports, Marine, and Trailer businesses. Our products help dealers, manufacturers, and industry stakeholders make smarter business decisions with data. You'll own the entire product lifecycle, from discovery to design to delivery and performance management, driving the product vision to meet customer needs, optimize revenue, and align with business goals.

  • Drive the vision & strategy for our data product portfolio based on customer research, market analysis, client interviews, and industry trends across the various industries we support.

  • Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for data products, from discovery through delivery, ensuring data is accurate, timely, and structured to support real business decisions.

  • Define, instrument, and achieve target KPIs tied to data product adoption, usage, and customer value.

  • Own the roadmap, balancing new data product development, BI platform enhancements, and custom reporting requests to drive both near-term adoption and long-term scalability.

  • Lead a cross-functional team to deliver high-quality, reliable data products, coordinating with engineering, QA, design, customer service, and sales.

  • Act as the subject-matter expert on customer and industry data needs, working directly with dealers, manufacturers, and other stakeholders to understand what data and reporting will improve their business decisions.

  • Analyze market trends, competitive data offerings, and customer feedback across RV, Powersports, Marine, and Trailer segments to shape product strategy.

  • Optimize products post-launch by tracking usage, adoption, revenue, and other success metrics.

What We're Looking For

  • 6+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 years managing data products, reporting tools, or BI/analytics platforms.

  • Experience supporting analytics, reporting, AI/ML, or decision-support use cases.

  • Experience with experimentation, A/B testing, and data-driven iteration; comfortable with BI and product-analytics dashboards.

  • A team player who can lead with clarity, move quickly, and navigate the fast-paced nature of cross-functional product development.

  • Strong communication skills, able to translate complex data concepts for both technical and executive/non-technical audiences.

  • Comfort with Agile Scrum or Kanban; excellent organizational skills to juggle multiple priorities.

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree in product management, business, data analytics, computer science, or a related field.

  • Familiarity with the RV, Powersports, Marine, Trailer, or adjacent dealer/OEM industries

En tant que CareCoach bilingue, vous mettrez à profit vos compétences interpersonnelles exceptionnelles et votre capacité à travailler sous pression tout en faisant preuve d'empathie et d'écoute active afin d'influencer positivement la santé mentale de vos clients. L'application de l'approche des soins progressifs (Stepped Care) et de l'approche « un à la fois », ainsi que des techniques telles que l'entretien motivationnel, la thérapie cognitivo--comportementale (TCC), la thérapie narrative et les soins adaptés aux traumatismes, constitueront la pierre angulaire de votre approche.

Rejoignez notre équipe et embarquez dans un parcours enrichissant, en ayant un impact significatif lors des moments les plus difficiles pour les clients.

raw.description:
Important Notice for Applicants:
At Bixal, we want to ensure a transparent and secure application process for all candidates. Official communication will come from an email address ending in @bixal.com or from @bixal.na.teamtailor-mail.com. Messages from other sources may be fraudulent, and you should exercise care to avoid any links or attachments included.

Bixal will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

Need Assistance or a Reasonable Accommodation?If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation to complete your application, we're here to help. Please reach out to us at and let us know how we can support you. You do not need to share personal details or disclose the nature of your request. You can expect a response from a team member within 24 hours during the regular work week and on the next operating day during the weekend or holidays.

Why Bixal?

Bixal is a consulting company headquartered in Fairfax, VA, working alongside governments and organizations to help them deliver better services and experiences to the communities they serve. Using evidence-based knowledge and technology, Bixal empowers clients to deliver on their missions more effectively by fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement.

Our values:

  • People-First: Emphasizing the importance of people in all aspects of work.

  • Collaboration and Transparency: Valuing teamwork and open communication.

  • Growth Mindset: Encouraging innovation and continuous improvement.

  • Creating Lasting Impact: Focusing on meaningful outcomes and positive change.

About the role:

Bixal is seeking a Senior SEO Specialist for a project that supports a large-scale outreach and engagement effort, delivering strategic communications, content and creative services, digital strategy, and audience engagement across public-facing websites, applications, and social media platforms. The work is paired with the IT, cybersecurity, and data operations needed to keep that digital presence secure, reliable, and available around the clock. The program's mission is to ensure the intended audience receives timely, accurate, and accessible information about the programs, services, and policies that affect them — with content and platforms built to scale, adapt to changing needs, and hold up to federal compliance and security standards.

The Senior SEO Specialist owns the program's search engine optimization strategy and execution, driving organic visibility and search performance across all public-facing websites and applications. This is a senior, largely autonomous role responsible for setting SEO benchmarks, running technical and content-based optimization programs, and advising Government stakeholders and content, communications, and social media teams on how to maximize discoverability — from traditional keyword and technical SEO through emerging areas like schema markup and voice search.

This is a full-time position contingent on contract award by our client, with a defined performance period of one year with two one-year option periods. This role offers you a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a project that aligns with Bixal’s mission of delivering innovative, human-centered solutions. While the role has a fixed duration, we are committed to transparency and collaboration, keeping you informed about contract updates and new opportunities. At Bixal, we support your professional journey, ensuring your experience reflects our inclusive, purpose-driven culture and prepares you for future success.

Location

This role can work remotely from anywhere in the USA. You must be legally authorized to work in the US.  Bixal does not provide visa sponsorship.

Compensation:

The salary range for this role is $100,000 – $110,000. In the spirit of transparency, most offers tend to land near the midpoint of the range. We make compensation decisions thoughtfully, considering your experience, the skills you bring, and our commitment to internal equity. Fairness and transparency are core to how we operate.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the end-to-end SEO program, conducting regular performance analyses benchmarked against Federal, DoD, and industry best practices, and delivering actionable recommendations to leadership.

  • Establish SEO baseline metrics and KPIs and report progress against targets on an ongoing basis.

  • Analyze search engine visibility, user behavior, conversion rates, and technical SEO health (e.g., page load speed, crawl/site errors), driving continuous optimization based on findings.

  • Conduct regular SEO validation checks (e.g., broken links, HTTP errors, and other site performance issues), coordinating remediation with technical stakeholders.

  • Lead keyword research focused on user intent and long-tail search behavior; design and implement internal linking, schema markup, and site-speed optimizations to improve organic rankings and click-through rates.

  • Develop and execute link-building and content-promotion strategies (e.g., press releases, content syndication, partnerships) to build domain authority; extend SEO strategy to voice search and event-specific landing pages.

  • Incorporate audience research and communications planning insights into keyword targeting and content-priority decisions.

  • Contribute SEO-specific test scenarios and success metrics to usability testing efforts, translating findings into optimization recommendations.

  • Advise across content strategy and lifecycle management on how SEO considerations should be embedded in planning and governance.

  • Advise content and editorial teams during content development on SEO best practices, ensuring new and updated content is optimized for search at the point of creation.

  • Provide SEO and keyword input to paid and earned media planning to ensure messaging and campaigns are optimized for reach and relevance.

  • Ensure social media and community-facing content is optimized for searchability and discoverability across digital engagement channels.

  • Provide keyword and search-trend guidance to social media content planning, informing editorial calendars and content themes to maximize organic reach.

  • Deliver staff training and workshops on SEO best practices to build organizational SEO literacy.

  • Provide regular SEO reporting and present findings/recommendations to Government stakeholders.

  • Other relevant duties as qualified/trained to perform

Qualifications:

  • This position requires an active Secret Clearance.

  • BA/BS in Marketing, Digital Communications, Data Analytics, or a related field.

  • Minimum 10 years of hands-on SEO experience, including technical SEO, on-page optimization, and content-driven SEO strategy for large, high-traffic websites.

  • Demonstrated experience with SEO/analytics tooling (e.g., Google Search Console, Google Analytics, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, or equivalent).

  • Proven experience setting and tracking SEO KPIs and delivering data-driven performance reporting to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Working knowledge of schema markup/structured data, site speed optimization, and technical SEO diagnostics.

  • Experience developing keyword strategy grounded in user intent and long-tail search research.

Nice to Have Skills and Experience:

  • Experience supporting SEO for a DoD, federal, or other large government-facing digital presence.

  • Experience with voice-search optimization and FAQ/structured content strategy.

  • Relevant certifications (e.g., Google Analytics, HubSpot SEO, SEMrush certifications).

  • Experience mentoring junior SEO or content staff.

How We Support Our Team:

  • Flex hours

  • 401K with matching incentive

  • Parental Leave

  • Medical/dental/vision benefits

  • Flex Spending Account

  • Company provided short-term disability and life insurance

  • Commuter benefits

  • Paid Time Off (PTO)

  • 11 Paid holidays

Our company is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all individuals and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local anti-discrimination laws. Employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.

raw.description:
TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of more than one million contributors from diverse backgrounds who help customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and contribute to the development of innovative AI technologies used by some of the world's largest brands.

Millions of people rely on digital maps every day to navigate, to discover, to find their way. But maps are only as accurate as the data behind them, and data is only as trustworthy as the people who verify it. Your knowledge of Serbia's geography, local landmarks, and how people actually navigate your region is something no algorithm can fully replicate. That local intelligence is what makes maps genuinely useful.

A Day in the Life of an Online Data Analyst

In this role, you will conduct structured quality audits on spatial and mapping datasets. Your role is to verify, evaluate, and validate complex geographic and business information using advanced mapping tools and detailed reference materials.

  • Conduct structured quality audits on spatial datasets using mapping platforms, search directories, and GIS-standard evaluation tools
  • Evaluate and cross-reference complex business, geographic, and cultural data entries against multiple authoritative sources
  • Perform root-cause analysis when spatial data points conflict across sources, documenting the discrepancy with precise reasoning
  • Apply detailed evaluation frameworks with consistency and rigor across dozens of geographic, business, and cultural data variations
  • Be open to work across a diverse set of Task Types (e.g. Maps, News, Audio tasks, Relevance)
  • Provide structured feedback that helps refine mapping algorithms and improve geographic intelligence

Why this matters: Accurately verified mapping data prevents real-world navigation errors. Your verification work ensures people can reliably find critical services, reach trusted businesses, and navigate with confidence. At scale, this is infrastructure work that is foundational to how billions of people interact with geographic information.

Why join the project:

  • Fully remote flexibility: Complete work from anywhere with stable internet, structuring your schedule around academic research, consulting, or other professional commitments
  • Structured onboarding: Access comprehensive evaluation guidelines, detailed reference materials, and practical examples before your first live assessment
  • Direct feedback and growth: Receive performance assessments tied to quality metrics so you can refine your evaluation precision
  • Intellectually rigorous work: Each evaluation requires methodical reasoning, framework interpretation, and structured discrepancy analysis.
  • Responsive support team: Contact dedicated contributor operations staff for clarification on guidelines, technical issues, or administrative questions

Qualification path

Requirements:

  • Professional fluency in English and Serbian - Latin and Cyrillic Script (native or near-native proficiency required)
  • Access to both Cyrillic and Latin keyboards is required
  • Residency in Serbia country for the last 5 consecutive years
  • Being open to work across a diverse set of Task Types (e.g. Maps, News, Audio tasks, Relevance)
  • Advanced analytical thinking and methodical problem-solving ability
  • Deep regional, cultural, and geographic knowledge of Serbia
  • Comfort with rigorous guideline interpretation and consistent framework application
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience in analytical, technical, or research disciplines (strongly preferred)
  • Stable internet connection and access to a personal computer

Qualification path

  • Complete your contributor profile and submit a brief background overview
  • Verify your identity through our secure identity verification process
  • Review the open-book study guide and evaluation framework (provided in your welcome materials)
  • Complete an open-book qualification assessment at your own pace within the time given
  • Receive your project assignment and access credentials

Please be aware that you may be required to rate tasks that relate to data from other countries or territories where the same language is spoken.

Service Rates

Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines.

Independent Contractor Relationship

This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital.

To apply, please reach us at by sending a copy of your CV along with the following details:

Year of Birth

Country Origin

Current Country of Residence

Native language and any additional languages spoken
